description: Source file implementing utility functions for Skia graphics library, including reading/writing SkString, SkFontIdentity, SkFontStyle, converting SkBitmap to N32 format, and converting SkColor to hex string.

methods.name: ReadSkString
methods.description: Reads a SkString from a PickleIterator.

methods.name: ReadSkFontIdentity
methods.description: Reads a FontIdentity object from a PickleIterator.

methods.name: ReadSkFontStyle
methods.description: Reads a SkFontStyle from a PickleIterator.

methods.name: WriteSkString
methods.description: Writes a SkString to a Pickle.

methods.name: WriteSkFontIdentity
methods.description: Writes a FontIdentity to a Pickle.

methods.name: WriteSkFontStyle
methods.description: Writes a SkFontStyle to a Pickle.

methods.name: SkBitmapToN32OpaqueOrPremul
methods.description: Converts a SkBitmap to N32 format with opaque or premultiplied alpha.

methods.name: SkColorToHexString
methods.description: Converts a SkColor to a hexadecimal string representation.
